mechanism_claims.claim_text: OAIP-1 causes an excitatory phenotype in injected mealworms, supporting neuroactive mechanism context while leaving the exact molecular target unresolved.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: synthetic OAIP-1 in Tenebrio molitor larvae
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper states the phenotype suggests possible ion-channel activation/gating modification or receptor agonism, but does not identify a direct molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The NMR structure shows a three-disulfide inhibitor cystine knot scaffold, supporting stability/structure context for oral activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural scaffold and stability context do not by themselves establish the insect molecular target.
